name: Mályinka (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Mályinka: a blue shield with a yellow tree and a white pale, between green branches, above a scroll inscribed MÁLYINKA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mályinka arms with branches and scroll
